scripts.build:worker: pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env development && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env development --outdir .open-next/dry-run-development && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir .open-next/dry-run-production
scripts.cf-typegen: rm -rf .open-next && wrangler types --env development --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts
scripts.cf-typegen:check: rm -rf .open-next && wrangler types --env development --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false --check cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts
scripts.deploy:development: pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env development && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env development
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env production && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env production
scripts.preview: pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env development && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env development
